selected_evidence.summary: The change succeeded; direct checks before and after reboot showed Timezone=America/Toronto and /etc/localtime targeting /usr/share/zoneinfo/America/Toronto.
Captured the healthy timezone baseline and old boot ID, acknowledged one scheduled reboot, proved the boot ID changed, and verified the timezone plus core services recovered.
ssh.service was already failed before the task and remained failed afterward; it was not modified.

commands.command: printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"; printf 'uid='; id -u; printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; printf 'timezone='; timedatectl show -p Timezone --value; printf 'localtime_target='; readlink -f /etc/localtime; printf 'local_time='; date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
